verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-hakeem
Hudan wa rahmatan lilmuhsineen
Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wa yu'toonaz-zakaata wa hum bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
Ulaa'ika alaa hudan min rabbihim wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa minan-naasi man yashtaree lahwal-hadeethi liyudilla an sabeelillaahi bighayri ilmin wa yattakhidhahaa huzuwan oola'ika lahum adhaabun muheen
Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhi aayaatunaa wallaa mustakbiran ka'an lam yasma'haa ka'anna fee udhunayhi waqran fabashshirhu bi-adhaabin aleem
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lahum jannaatun-na'eem
Khaalideena feehaa wa'da Allaahi haqqan wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem

Khalaqas-samaawaati bighayri amadin tarawnahaa wa alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa baththa feehaa min kulli daabbatin wa anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-anbatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
Haadhaa khalqu Allaahi fa-aroonee maadhaa khalaqal-ladheena min doonihi baliz-zaalimoona fee dalaalin mubeen
Wa laqad aataynaa luqmaanal-hikmata anish-kur Lillaahi wa man yashkur fa-innamaa yashkuru linafsihi wa man kafara fa-innallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
Wa idh qaala luqmaanu liaabnihi wa huwa ya'izuhu yaa bunayya laa tushrik Billaahi innash-shirka lazulmun azeem
Wa wassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi hamalathu ummuhu wahnan alaa wahnin wa fisaaluhu fee aamayni anish-kur lee wa liwaalidayka ilayyal-maseer

Wa in jaahadaaka alaa an tushrika bee maa laysa laka bihi ilmun falaa tuti'humaa wa saahibhumaa fid-dunyaa ma'roofan wattabi sabeela man anaaba ilayya thumma ilayya marji'ukum fa-unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Yaa bunayya innahaa in takun mithqaala habbatin min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fis-samaawaati aw fil-ardi ya'ti bihaa Allaahu innallaaha lateefun khabeer
Yaa bunayya aqimis-salaata wa mur bil-ma'roofi wanha anil-munkari wasbir alaa maa asaabaka inna dhaalika min azmil-umoor
Wa laa tusa'ir khaddaka lin-naasi wa laa tamshi fil-ardi marahan innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
Waaqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtika inna ankaral-aswaati lasawtul-hameer

Alam taraw annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa asbagha alaykum ni'amahu zaahiratan wa baatinatan wa minan-naasi man yujaadilu fee Allaahi bighayri ilmin wa laa hudan wa laa kitaabin muneer
Wa idhaa qeela lahumu ittabi'oo maa anzala Allaahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa alayhi aabaa'anaa awalaw kaanash-shaytaanu yad'oohum ilaa adhaabis-sa'eer
Wa man yuslim wajhahu ilaa Allaahi wa huwa muhsinun faqadi istamsaka bil-urwatil-wuthqaa wa ilaa Allaahi aaqibatul-umoor
Wa man kafara falaa yahzunka kufruhu ilaynaa marji'uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa amiloo innallaaha aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Numatti'uhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ilaa adhaabin ghaleez
Wa la-in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunna Allaahu qulil-hamdu Lillaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
Wa law annamaa fil-ardi min shajaratin aqlaamun wal-bahru yamudduhu min ba'dihi sab'atu abhurin maa nafidat kalimaatu Allaahi innallaaha azeezun hakeem
Maa khalqukum wa laa ba'thukum illaa kanafsin waahidatin innallaaha samee'un baseer
Alam taraa annallaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa yoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajree ilaa ajalin musamman wa annallaaha bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha huwal-haqqu wa anna maa yad'oona min doonihil-baatilu wa annallaaha huwal-aliyyul-kabeer
Alam taraa annal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bini'mati Allaahi liyuriyakum min aayaatihi inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Wa idhaa ghashiyahum mawjun kaz-zulali da'aw Allaaha mukhliseena lahud-deena falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri faminhum muqtasidun wa maa yajhadu bi-aayaatinaa illaa kullu khattaarin kafoor

Yaa ayyuhan-naasu ittaqoo rabbakum wakhshaw yawman laa yajzee wa-dun an waladihi wa laa mawloodun huwa jaazin an wa-dihi shay'an inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaa utud-dunyaa wa laa yaghurrannakum Billaahil-gharoor
Innallaaha indahu ilmus-saa'ati wa yunazzilul-ghaytha wa ya'lamu maa fil-arhaami wa maa tadree nafsun maadhaa taksibu ghadan wa maa tadree nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamootu innallaaha aleemun khabeer
